archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy - Adapted for Local Service Trust)
design_philosophy: High-end, trustworthy local service aesthetic. Avoid the typical 'cheap contractor' look. Use deep slate blues and vibrant leaf greens to build credibility. Generous whitespace, crisp typography, and high-quality photography to position the business as Jacksonville's premium choice.

patterns.hero: Relative container with high-quality background image, heavy white-to-transparent or dark-to-transparent gradient overlay to ensure text contrast. Keep CTA text left-aligned.
patterns.services: Bento-style grid (Mode A). Use col-span-12 md:col-span-4 for cards. Cards should have p-8, bg-white, border border-slate-200, shadow-sm, hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300.
patterns.admin: Control Room grid (Mode B). Dense data presentation using Shadcn Tables. Tight gap-4, h-full utilization.

surfaces.header: Sticky with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200 z-50. Include a top announcement bar (bg-blue-900 text-white) for the 10% new customer discount.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-900 text-white hover:bg-blue-800 rounded-lg px-8 py-4 font-semibold shadow-md transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 rounded-lg px-8 py-4 font-semibold shadow-md transition-colors
buttons.outline: border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-900 hover:border-slate-900 rounded-lg px-8 py-4 font-semibold transition-colors

marketing.strategy: Custom HTML/Tailwind. Do not use Shadcn for the main marketing layouts. Use raw divs, sections for fluid asymmetrical layouts.
marketing.hero_cta: Use large H1, prominent Primary Button ('Get a Free Quote'), and a Secondary Outline Button ('Call 877-736-0586').
marketing.testimonials: Grid of cards with client photos, 5-star SVG icons, and verified text.
marketing.faq: Can use Shadcn Accordion customized to fit the theme.
marketing.pricing_tables: 3-column grid showing typical costs (e.g., Single Story, Two Story, Commercial). Use heavy borders for the 'Recommended' tier.
marketing.process_steps: Vertical timeline or 6-block grid using bold numerals (01, 02...) in JetBrains Mono or large Cabinet Grotesk.

interactive.strategy: Use customized Shadcn components for forms, tables, and accordions.
interactive.contact_form: Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea, Button. Ensure robust validation.
interactive.admin_panel: Shadcn Table for Leads, Card for quick stats. Simple layout: Sidebar nav + main content area.

hero_background.description: Florida house exterior for the main hero section. Use a white gradient overlay from the left.

service_worker.description: Professional working on roof/gutters. Use in About Us or Services section.

before_gutter.description: Dirty gutters. Use in Before/After section.

after_gutter.description: Clean water flowing. Use in Before/After section.

media.icons_strategy: Use lucide-react (already installed). Key icons: CheckCircle (green) for trust badges, Phone, MapPin, Star (amber), Shield (blue).

seo_and_content.h1_strategy: Include 'Gutter Cleaning Jacksonville Florida' naturally in the H1.
seo_and_content.trust_badges: Always visible 'Licensed & Insured', '10% New Customer Discount', '5-Star Rated'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all marketing layouts use custom HTML/Tailwind classes (divs, sections), not Shadcn structural components.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings, strictly tracking-tight.
Integrate Lucide React icons for trust badges (Shield, CheckCircle2) prominently in the hero and footer.
Ensure the contact form routes to the backend and inserts into the database, viewable via the Admin panel.
Embed real Google Maps iframe on the Service Area page using the provided address.
The admin panel must use Shadcn Table for leads. Keep it simple and functional.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
Install specific fonts via Google Fonts in index.css (Cabinet Grotesk / Manrope).
